work.description: Modern institutional catalogue notice identifying Bede’s Mark commentary and reporting a composition range of 725-730. Bibale aligns the notice with FAMA work 326170. This is a catalogue assertion about the medieval work, not a primary medieval witness or an independent examination of its dating argument.
